items.text: to clear a way through the snow (doer: the woman)
items.evidence: 0.12-3.88s the woman shovels snow out of the narrow path between deep snow walls; the P1 red box is on her throughout.

items.text: to squeeze past the woman (doer: the dog)
items.evidence: The husky comes along the left snow bank (0.12-1.38s), drops into the narrow path beside her (1.62-2.12s) and passes in front of her toward the camera (2.38-3.38s); the P2 blue box follows it.

items.text: to give a thumbs-up through the window (doer: the man)
items.evidence: Window crops of all 16 frames: the man points (0.12-0.88s), then raises a clenched fist and cheers (1.12-2.62s), then lowers his arm and laughs (2.88-3.88s). There is no thumbs-up at any time.
items.fix_hint: to cheer behind the window / to point through the window

items.evidence: On the nouns still the point is at the right snow wall beside the woman's legs, on the wall face rather than clearly on the cleared path.
items.fix_hint: move the point onto the path floor, e.g. (0.35,0.85)

items.text: story: Anna cleared a way through the snow.
story: Her husky squeezed past and ran down it first.
items.evidence: The squeeze past is visible (1.62-2.88s). From 2.38-3.38s the dog walks/trots down the path toward the camera; it is not clearly running.
items.fix_hint: Her husky squeezed past and walked down it first.

items.evidence: The man inside laughs and cheers at the window (1.12-3.88s); the spoken line is allowed fiction.
